item.description: The Flask hook implementation incorrectly stores and retrieves route information. It attempts to store route information on functions via __route__ attribute, but Flask's route decorator doesn't properly attach this metadata. Additionally, Flask's errorhandler decorator doesn't work the same way as expected.
item.contract: Flask route decorators (@app.route) should properly extract and store route information for labeling HTTP requests. Flask errorhandler decorators (@app.errorhandler) should also be properly detected and labeled. The hook implementation should correctly extract route information from Flask's internal route mapping.

item.description: The Flask hook implementation doesn't correctly integrate with Flask's application request processing pipeline. The hook needs to ensure that Flask's internal routing and execution pipeline correctly integrates with httpdbg's recording mechanism.
item.contract: When Flask processes a request, the hook should capture the appropriate route information and ensure the request is properly grouped and labeled in the HTTP records. The hook should work with Flask's internal mechanisms to capture route-specific metadata.

item.description: The Flask hook implementation doesn't properly handle the wrapping of Flask routes. The current approach of storing attributes on functions doesn't align with how Flask internally manages routes and endpoints.
item.contract: The Flask hook must correctly wrap Flask route functions to capture their route information and ensure proper labeling in the HTTP records. The hook should work with Flask's actual endpoint resolution mechanism to identify and label routes.
